1: // Neon Runner – minimal endless runner
2: // Canvas with id "game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
6: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: // Audio setup
8: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9: function playSound(freq, duration) {
10:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:   osc.type = 'sine';
13:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:   osc.connect(gain);
15:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:   osc.start();
19:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20: }
21: 
22: 
23: // Resize canvas to fill its container
24: function resize() {
25:   const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
26:   canvas.width = rect.width;
27:   canvas.height = rect.height;
28: }
29: window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
30: resize();
31: 
32: // Player (neon square)
33: const player = {
34:   x: 50, // constant horizontal position
35:   y: 0,
36:   size: 20,
37:   vy: 0,
38:   color: '#0ff',
39:   onGround: false,
40: };
41: const GRAVITY = 0.6;
42: const JUMP = -12;
43: 
44: // World segments scrolling leftward
45: let segments = [];
46: const SEG_LEN = 100; // width of each segment
47: let nextSegX = canvas.width; // x coordinate where next segment starts
48: let speed = 3; // scrolling speed
49: let score = 0;
50: let prevScore = 0;
51: let highScore = Number(localStorage.getItem('highScore')) || 0;
52: let gameOver = false;
53: 
54: function spawnSegment() {
55:   const hasGround = Math.random() > 0.2; // 80% ground
56:   const hasSpike = hasGround && Math.random() < 0.2; // occasional spikes
57:   segments.push({ x: nextSegX, width: SEG_LEN, hasGround, hasSpike });
58:   nextSegX += SEG_LEN;
59: }
60: 
61: // Fill initial segments
62: while (nextSegX < canvas.width * 2) spawnSegment();
63: 
64: // Input – tap/click or spacebar to jump
65: // Ensure audio context is resumed on user interaction
66: function resumeAudio(){ if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }
67: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { resumeAudio(); if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
68: window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { resumeAudio(); jump(); });
69: function jump() { if (player.onGround) { player.vy = JUMP; player.onGround = false; playSound(700, 0.1); } }
70: 
71: function endGame() { playSound(150, 0.4); gameOver = true; }
72: 
73: function update() {
74:   if (gameOver) return;
75: 
76:   // Player physics
77:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
78:   player.y += player.vy;
79: 
80:   const groundY = canvas.height - 30;
81:   const seg = segments.find(s => player.x >= s.x && player.x < s.x + s.width);
82:   const onGroundSegment = seg && seg.hasGround;
83:   const onSpike = seg && seg.hasSpike && player.x > seg.x && player.x < seg.x + seg.width && player.y + player.size > groundY - 20;
84: 
85:   if (onSpike) endGame();
86: 
87:   // Landing logic
88:   if (player.y + player.size >= groundY) {
89:     if (onGroundSegment) {
90:       player.y = groundY - player.size;
91:       player.vy = 0;
92:       player.onGround = true;
93:     } else {
94:       endGame(); // fell into gap
95:     }
96:   }
97: 
98:   // Scroll world
99:   for (let i = segments.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
100:     segments[i].x -= speed;
101:     if (segments[i].x + segments[i].width < 0) segments.splice(i, 1);
102:   }
103:   if (nextSegX - speed < canvas.width * 2) spawnSegment();
104:   nextSegX -= speed;
105: 
106:   // Score based on distance travelled
107:   const newScore = Math.floor((canvas.width - player.x + speed * (segments.length * SEG_LEN)) / 10);
108:   if (newScore > score) {
109:     playSound(300, 0.05); // incremental score sound
110:   }
111:   score = newScore;
112:   if (score > highScore) {
113:     highScore = score;
114:     localStorage.setItem('highScore', highScore);
115:   }
116: }
117: 
118: function draw() {
119:     // Clear background with gradient and stars
120:     const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
121:     bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
122:     bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#003');
123:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
124:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
125:     // simple starfield
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
128:       const sx = Math.random() * canvas.width;
129:       const sy = Math.random() * canvas.height;
130:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
131:     }
132: 
133: 
134:   // Ground and spikes with neon style
135:   const groundY = canvas.height - 30;
136:   // Ground gradient
137:   const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, groundY + 30);
138:   groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f8');
139:   groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#070');
140:   ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
141:   for (const s of segments) {
142:     if (s.hasGround) {
143:       // Draw ground segment
144:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, groundY, s.width, 30);
145:       // Add neon glow effect
146:       ctx.shadowColor = '#0f8';
147:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
148:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, groundY, s.width, 30);
149:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
150:       if (s.hasSpike) {
151:         // Spike gradient
152:         const spikeGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY - 20, 0, groundY);
153:         spikeGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f44');
154:         spikeGrad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
155:         ctx.fillStyle = spikeGrad;
156:         ctx.beginPath();
157:         ctx.moveTo(s.x + s.width / 2 - 5, groundY);
158:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width / 2 + 5, groundY);
159:         ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.width / 2, groundY - 20);
160:         ctx.closePath();
161:         ctx.fill();
162:         // Reset fill style for ground
163:         ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
164:       }
165:     }
166:   }
167: 
168:   // Player with neon glow
169:   ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
170:   ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
171:   ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
172:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
173:   ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
174: 
175:   // UI
176:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
178:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
179:   ctx.fillText(`High: ${highScore}`, 10, 40);
180: 
181:   if (gameOver) {
182:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
183:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
185:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
186:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
187:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
188:   }
189: }
190: 
191: function loop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
192: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
